test_title: PYST 18: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 15 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
The given sentence is in active voice. Change the voice of the sentence. Select the correct option from the sentences given in options.

I know he will play his guitar.

options.text: His guitar will be played by him is something I know.
It is known to me that his guitar would be played by him.
It is known to me that his guitar will be played by him.
His guitar will be played by him is know to me.

solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 3'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The given sentence** "I know he will play his guitar" is in the** active voice**, where the subject** "I" **is **performing the action** of knowing.
 
• To change it to the passive voice, we need to make the object of the active sentence (his guitar) the subject of the passive sentence, and the subject of the active sentence (he) becomes the object in the passive sentence.
 
• **"It"** becomes the subject of the passive sentence,** "is known" **is the passive verb construction, and **"to me" **indicates the agent or the person who knows.
 
• "That his guitar will be played by him" is the** passive clause** with "his guitar" as the subject, "will be played" as the passive verb construction, and "by him" as the agent or the person performing the action.

Therefore, the **correct passive transformation** is: *"It is known to me that his guitar will be played by him."*
